description: Relations aux isséens par canal de communication is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville d'Issy-les-Moulineaux. This game presents the number of calls, letters, emails, appointments and visits to the administrative centre processed by the one-stop shop “Information Receipt des Isséens” (IRIS) between 2017 and 2019. These data are indicators of the Qualiville annual balance sheet. Coverage: Issy-les-Moulineaux. The portal shows the English title as "Relations to isseans by channel of communication" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville d'Issy-les-Moulineaux. Its keywords include communication, dataviz1, iris, service-public. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2019-05-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
